:::{#exm-precision-zero-cind}
#### A chain of three Gaussian variables

<!-- no-figure: one 3 x 3 matrix and its inverse; nothing to plot -->

Let $\vX = \tp{(X_1, X_2, X_3)}$ have mean $\matr{0}$ and [precision matrix](#def-precision-matrix)

$$
\precision(\vX) = \pmat{2 & -1 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 2}.
$$

By @thm-precision-matrix-inverse, the [variance matrix](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cov-vec-x) is the [inverse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-matrix-inverse) of this matrix,

$$
\Varf{\vX} = \frac{1}{4} \pmat{3 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 4 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3},
$$

which one can check by multiplying the two matrices to get $\matr{I}_3$.
So $\Covs{X_1}{X_3} = 1/4 \ne 0$, and $X_1$ and $X_3$ are not independent.
But the $(1, 3)$ element of the precision matrix is 0,
so by @thm-precision-zero-cind, $X_1$ and $X_3$ are conditionally independent given $X_2$:
once $X_2$ is known, $X_1$ carries no further information about $X_3$.

:::
